company.name: Entvin
company.shortDescription: Entvin deploys secure AI solutions for life-sciences, enabling advanced workflows for R&D, clinical trials, and regulatory compliance.
company.description: Entvin provides an agent platform that supports drug formulation and development in pharmaceutical research. The platform includes Labeling AI, which helps regulatory teams manage updates and compare competitor labels, and Ads Promo AI, which checks promotional materials against regulatory standards to identify compliance risks. It allows instant access to FDA, EMA, and TGA databases with automated alerts for regulatory changes. The AI Label Drafter can also generate draft labels and convert them into structured formats for regulatory submission. To protect sensitive data, Entvin complies with SOC2, ISO, HIPAA, and GDPR standards while maintaining strong security measures. The platform is hosted in a private cloud environment, ensuring that user activity logs and data are handled securely.
